topic: End-of-service calculations that used to take a spreadsheet morning now run in seconds
format: Open with a SmartPRO Hub product capability, then show the real-world business outcome it enables
post:
End-of-service calculations used to eat a full morning.

HR managers in Oman know exactly what that looks like: pull the hire date, check the contract type, calculate the entitlement bands, cross-reference the Labour Law — then repeat for every employee on the list.

One manufacturing company in Muscat was doing this manually every time someone left. With 140 employees, that added up to hours of spreadsheet work per cycle. One formula error meant starting from scratch.

After moving to SmartPRO Hub, the same calculation — contract type, service duration, entitlement rate — runs in seconds. No spreadsheet. No morning lost.

That time saving is real, but it's not the main point. Manual end-of-service errors carry actual financial and compliance risk. These numbers feed directly into WPS payroll records and Ministry of Labour filings. There's no margin for a copy-paste mistake at that stage.

Faster is good. Accurate every time is better.

If your HR team is still building these in Excel, the tool is working against you.
